original_ai_prompt: Design the wired network for one college building: a computer lab with 16 student PCs, four classrooms with 3 PCs each, and a staff room with 5 PCs. Students and staff must be on separate networks; the classrooms count as student machines. Cable internet. Leave guest WiFi out of scope for now.
cleaned_prompt: Design the wired network for one college building: a computer lab with 16 student PCs, four classrooms with 3 PCs each, and a staff room with 5 PCs. Students and staff must be on separate networks; the classrooms count as student machines. Cable internet. Leave guest WiFi out of scope for now.

requirements.statement: Students and staff are on separate networks
Lab and classroom PCs are both student machines

expected_behaviour: Two VLANs (students combining lab+classrooms, staff), cable internet. Guest explicitly out of scope, so no isolation gap.
capability_limitations: Two VLANs (students combining lab+classrooms, staff), cable internet. Guest explicitly out of scope, so no isolation gap.
why_suitable: Campus realism WITHOUT triggering the guest-isolation refusal — shows scope-cutting as a legitimate design move, and keeps an English campus case in the pool.
